45609-the-history-of-the-confederate-war.title: A Narrative and Critical History
45609-the-history-of-the-confederate-war.creator: George Cary Eggleston
45609-the-history-of-the-confederate-war.description: A book by George Cary Eggleston. There are not that many men in all the regular standing armies of Europe combined, even if we include the unpaid hordes of Turkey and the military myriads of the armed camp known to geography as Russia.

46418-petals-plucked-from-sunny-climes.title: Petals Plucked From Sunny Climes
46418-petals-plucked-from-sunny-climes.creator: Unknown
46418-petals-plucked-from-sunny-climes.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. arranging the historical portion of this work, I have endeavored to sift conflicting events, at all times retaining those which were the most tangible, and rejecting many which have been received by superficial observers as consistent truths.

arxiv-1909-10595.title: Scaling Behaviour of Low-Temperature Orthorhombic Domains in Prototypical High-Temperature Superconductor La 1.875 Ba 0.125 CuO 4
arxiv-1909-10595.creator: T. A. Assefa, Y. Cao, J. Diao, K. Kisslinger, G. D. Gu, J. M. Tranquada, M. P. M. Dean, I. K. Robinson
arxiv-1909-10595.description: Abstract Translational/rotational symmetry breaking and recovery in condensed matter systems are closely related to exotic physical properties such as superconductivity (SC), magnetism, spin density waves (SDW) and charge density waves (CDW). The interplay between different order parameters is intricate and often subject to intense debate, as in the case of CDW order and superconductivity. In La 1.875 Ba 0.

arxiv-2107-02542.title: Wilson line correlators beyond the large- N c N_{c}
arxiv-2107-02542.creator: Johannes Hamre Isaksen, and Konrad Tywoniuk
arxiv-2107-02542.description: Abstract We study hard 1 → 2 1\to 2 final-state parton splittings in the medium, and put special emphasis on calculating the Wilson line correlators that appear in these calculations. As partons go through the medium their color continuously rotates, an effect that is encapsulated in a Wilson line along their trajectory.

arxiv-2107-09464.title: Shape Optimization for the Mitigation of Coastal Erosion via Shallow Water Equations
arxiv-2107-09464.creator: Luka Schlegel, Volker Schulz
arxiv-2107-09464.description: Abstract Coastal erosion describes the displacement of land caused by destructive sea waves, currents or tides. Major efforts have been made to mitigate these effects using groins, breakwaters and various other structures. We address this problem by applying shape optimization techniques on the obstacles.

arxiv-2203-06523.title: A time-fractional dual-phase-lag framework to investigate transistors with TMTC channels (TiS 3 , In 4 Se 3 ) and size-dependent properties
arxiv-2203-06523.creator: Mohammad Hosein Fotovvat, Zahra Shomali
arxiv-2203-06523.description: Abstract In this study, a time fractional dual-phase-lag model with temperature jump boundary condition as a choice for the Fourier’s law replacement in thermal modeling of transistors, is utilized. In more details, the numerical simulation of heat transfer in newly proposed TMTC field effect transistors using fractional DPL equation has been investigated.

arxiv-2505-10194.title: Passive Channel Charting: Locating Passive Targets using a UWB Mesh
arxiv-2505-10194.creator: Raffael Poeggel 1 {}^{\textbf{1}}, Maximilian Stahlke 1 {}^{\textbf{1}}, Jonas Pirkl 1 {}^{\textbf{1}}, Jonathan Ott 1 {}^{\textbf{1}}, George Yammine 1 {}^{\textbf{1}}
arxiv-2505-10194.description: Abstract Fingerprint-based passive localization enables high localization accuracy using low-cost UWB IoT radio sensors. However, fingerprinting demands extensive effort for data acquisition. The concept of channel charting reduces this effort by modeling and projecting the manifold of csi ( csi ) onto a 2D coordinate space.

arxiv-2509-12192.title: New constraints on Z ′ Z^{\prime} from captured dark matter annihilation in astrophysical objects
arxiv-2509-12192.creator: Basabendu Barman, Pooja Bhattacharjee, Arindam Das
arxiv-2509-12192.description: Abstract Considering dark matter capture in astrophysical objects such as neutron stars and brown dwarfs, followed by their annihilation into two neutrino and four neutrino final states, we derive new constraints on the mass and coupling of a novel abelian gauge boson Z ′ Z^{\prime} arising from an anomaly-free U ⁡ ( 1 ) U(1) extension of the Standard Model.

arxiv-2509-23516.title: Network-Optimised Spiking Neural Network for Event-Driven Networking
arxiv-2509-23516.creator: Muhammad Bilal School of Computing and Communications, Lancaster University, LA1 4WA Lancaster, United Kingdom m.bilal@ieee.org
arxiv-2509-23516.description: Abstract Spiking neural networks support event-driven computation suited to time-critical networking tasks such as anomaly detection, local routing control, and congestion management at the edge. However, classical units, including Hodgkin–Huxley, Izhikevich, and the Random Neural Network, map poorly to these needs.

arxiv-2512-12167.title: Extending the Context of Pretrained LLMs by Dropping Their Positional Embeddings
arxiv-2512-12167.creator: Yoav Gelberg, Koshi Eguchi, Takuya Akiba, Edoardo Cetin
arxiv-2512-12167.description: Abstract So far, expensive finetuning beyond the pretraining sequence length has been a requirement for effectively extending the context of language models (LM). In this work, we break this key bottleneck by Dro pping the P ositional E mbeddings of LMs after training (DroPE) . Our simple method is motivated by three key theoretical and empirical observations.

arxiv-2601-05692.title: Bouchet’s conjecture for cyclically 5-edge-connected, cubic signed graphs
arxiv-2601-05692.creator: Kathryn Nurse
arxiv-2601-05692.description: Abstract A 1983 conjecture of Bouchet states that every flow-admissible signed graph has a nowhere-zero six-flow. We prove this conjecture for cyclically five-edge-connected, cubic signed graphs. 1 Introduction Nowhere-zero flows on signed graphs generalize nowhere-zero flows on graphs, and are motivated by embeddings of graphs in non-orientable surfaces [ 2 ] .

arxiv-2601-19864.title: Viscosity Solutions in Martinet Spaces
arxiv-2601-19864.creator: Thomas Bieske, Frederic Bowen
arxiv-2601-19864.description: Abstract . In this paper, we establish the properties of viscosity solutions in Martinet spaces, which lack both the algebraic group law of Carnot groups and the triangular vector fields of Grushin-type spaces. We then prove the uniqueness of viscosity solutions to strictly monotone elliptic PDEs and to the infinite Laplace equation.

arxiv-2603-02840.creator: Thomas L. Lee, Edoardo M. Ponti, Amos Storkey

britannica-1911-paulus.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-paulus.description: Article 'Paulus' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 20), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. the ushers appointed to maintain silence within the imperial palace), Greek poet, contemporary and friend of Agathias, during the reign of Justinian.

europmc-pmc2000966.title: A single mutation in the PB1-F2 of H5N1 (HK/97) and 1918 influenza A viruses contributes to increased virulence.
europmc-pmc2000966.creator: Conenello GM, Zamarin D, Perrone LA, Tumpey T, Palese P.
europmc-pmc2000966.description: The proapoptotic PB1-F2 protein of influenza A viruses has been shown to contribute to pathogenesis in the mouse model. Expression of full-length PB1-F2 increases the pathogenesis of the influenza A virus, causing weight loss, slower viral clearance, and increased viral titers...

pmc-11397278.title: Phenological Analysis of Grasses (Poaceae) in Comparison with Aerobiological Data in Moscow (Russia)
pmc-11397278.creator: Elena E Severova, Vera S Karaseva, Yulia M Selezneva, Svetlana S Polevova
pmc-11397278.description: Grasses (Poaceae) produce large amounts of pollen and are among the main causes of pollinosis worldwide. Despite their morphological similarity, pollen grains of different grass species may have different allergenicities. Therefore, quantification of the roles of individual species in airborne pollen is an important task.

pmc-11421205.title: Multicenter exploration of specialist palliative care in patients with left ventricular assist devices – a retrospective study
pmc-11421205.creator: Theresa Tenge, Shaylin Shahinzad, Stefan Meier, Manuela Schallenburger, Yann-Nicolas Batzler, Jacqueline Schwartz, Anja Coym, Johannes Rosenbruch, Mitra Tewes, Steffen T. Simon, Carmen Roch, Ute Hiby, Christian Jung, Udo Boeken, Jan Gaertner, Martin Neukirchen
pmc-11421205.description: BackgroundThe number of advanced heart failure patients with left ventricular assist devices (LVAD) is increasing. Despite guideline-recommendations, little is known about specialist palliative care involvement in LVAD-patients, especially in Europe. This study aims to investigate timing and setting of specialist palliative care in LVAD-patients.MethodsWe conducted a retrospective multicenter study in 2022.

pmc-12374876.title: Functional exercise training in persons with multiple sclerosis: a systematic review
pmc-12374876.creator: Frederike Adammek, Weronika Gralla, Marie Kupjetz, Annette Rademacher, Philipp Zimmer, Eduard Isenmann, Niklas Joisten
pmc-12374876.description: Functional exercise training focuses on enhancing the body’s capacity for everyday movements by targeting a combination of strength, stability, balance, coordination, and flexibility. More flexible and less standardized exercise approaches, such as functional exercise training, may offer further benefits on improving symptoms in persons with MS (pwMS), but they have been less investigated.

pmc-12400751.title: Key stakeholders’ perspectives on implementation of risk-based population breast cancer screening in Australia – “We can either get on the bus or get under it”
pmc-12400751.creator: Jocelyn Lippey, Louise Keogh, Stephanie Best, Rebecca Purvis, Gregory Bruce Mann, Laura Forrest
pmc-12400751.description: BackgroundRisk-based breast cancer screening would be a dramatic shift from the current one-size-fits-all model to a tailored approach where screening modality and frequency is directed by individual risk. This project assesses what key stakeholders, defined as those holding managerial and decision-making roles within BreastScreen, consider the issues are with implementing a risk-based approach to screening.

pmc-12460010.title: Iron Supplementation at 1 mg/kg/Day for Exclusively Breastfed Full-Term Infants: A Meta-Analysis
pmc-12460010.creator: Suyu Wang, Yayu Zhang, Dan Song, Hua Mei, Zhiying You, Xiaofang Xu, Yuqi Zhang
pmc-12460010.description: Aim: The aim for the study is to evaluate the effects of 1 mg/kg/day iron supplementation on hematologic and growth parameters in exclusively breastfed full-term infants. Methods: We conducted a meta-analysis of seven RCTs (n = 1114) comparing iron supplementation with placebo/no intervention. Primary outcomes included hemoglobin (Hb), serum ferritin (SF), mean corpuscular volume (MCV), height, and weight.

pmc-12471456.title: Enzymatic Evolution and Longitudinal Recovery in Biotinidase Deficiency: Genotypic and Clinical Insights from the Follow-Up of a Newborn-Screened Cohort in Emilia-Romagna, Italy
pmc-12471456.creator: Rita Ortolano, Soara Menabò, Egidio Candela, Giacomo Biasucci, Elisa Bortolamedi, Giulia Montanari, Alessandro Zuccotti, Umberto Cattini, Marcello Lanari, Federico Baronio, Peter Oefner
pmc-12471456.description: Background/Objectives: Biotinidase deficiency (BD) is a treatable autosomal recessive disorder included in many newborn screening (NBS) programs. The importance of early diagnosis and treatment is now well established. However, recent studies are emerging on the possibility of increased enzyme activity with age, an observation that raises questions about the long-term validity of the initial classification of these patients.

pmc-12573880.title: 1690-Fold enhanced electrochemiluminescence of gold nanoclusters via Zn2+ induced aggregation
pmc-12573880.creator: Yujiao Wang, Xuwen Gao, Qinqing Zhang, Xiaoxuan Ren, Guizheng Zou
pmc-12573880.description: Herein, a zinc ion (Zn2+)-induced aggregation strategy is proposed for 1690-fold enhanced electrochemiluminescence (ECL) from d-penicillamine (DPA)-capped gold nanoclusters (AuNCs), and the aggregation-induced ECL (AIECL) is a multiplicative effect of two enhancing factors. One is the improved ligand rigidification of Zn2+-induced aggregation of AuNCs, i.e. Zn2+-AuNCs.

pmc-13161352.title: Evaluating the Air Respiratory Capacity of Awaous (Chonophorus) tajasica (Gobiiformes: Oxudercidae): A Morpho‐Functional Study
pmc-13161352.creator: João Pedro Trevisan, Diego Venturelli, Wilfried Klein, André Luis da Cruz
pmc-13161352.description: Surface air‐gulping behavior has been reported in several gobiid fishes, but its contribution to oxygen uptake remains unclear. This study aimed to evaluate the air‐breathing capacity of Awaous tajasica through behavioral observations, measurement of oxygen consumption, and analysis of the functional morphology of its palate and gills.

pmc-13239657.title: Investigating haemodynamic changes during vaginal delivery in low-risk pregnant women and the association between haemodynamic and adverse pregnancy outcomes: an ambispective cohort study protocol
pmc-13239657.creator: Cheng Chen, Dawei Guo, Ting Zhou, Wei Xu, Yi Yang, Zaimei Tang, Hua Zhang, Longqiong Wang, Xinyang Yu
pmc-13239657.description: IntroductionThe progressive adaptation of the maternal cardiovascular system throughout pregnancy is essential to maintaining adequate uteroplacental circulation and meeting maternal physiological demands. In recent years, maternal haemodynamic parameters have gained attention as useful indicators for screening and managing pregnancy, particularly for identifying women at high risk for complications and predicting adverse pregnancy outcomes.

pmc-13269740.title: Co-Contamination and Combined Effects of Microplastic and Microbial Load on Water Quality and Public Health Risks in Industrial and Urban Canals of Coastal Bangladesh
pmc-13269740.creator: Nayema Subrin Ahmed, Mehedi Mahmudul Hasan, Khadijatul Kubra Riya, Firoz Ahmed, Takaomi Arai, Nurul Aini Kamaruddin, Mohammad Belal Hossain

pmc-13290757.creator: Kristen D. Krause, Ricardo Kairios, Taylor Masamitsu, Kendall Lyra, Aly Maier Lokuta

pmc-13310493.title: Baseline Nutritional Indices as Prognostic Indicators in Patients with Recurrent or Metastatic Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma Treated with the PD-L1 Inhibitor KL-A167: A Secondary Analysis of the KL-A167 Trial
pmc-13310493.creator: Huilin Li, Zheran Liu, Jiacheng Li, Zhigong Wei, Ruidan Li, Yiyan Pei, Yu Min, Ge Song, Kun Gao, Zijian Qin, Junyou Ge, Yan Qing, Youneng Wei, Jitao Zhou, Xingchen Peng

pmc-13332022.title: In vivo tissue clearing with tartrazine and other dye molecules
pmc-13332022.creator: Victoria Crunkleton, Guosong Hong
pmc-13332022.description: Tartrazine, along with many other absorbing molecules, has recently emerged as a promising tissue-clearing agent for achieving transient and reversible optical transparency in live animals. In this mini-review, we describe the fundamental physical origins of tissue opacity, extract engineering principles guiding the design of next-generation dye-based clearing agents, and summarize recent advances in dye-enabled in vivo tissue clearing.

pmc-13337304.title: The Reconstructive Pelvic Anatomy classification system
pmc-13337304.creator: William J J Collins, Daniel Franks, Ian A Harris, Verinder S Sidhu, Maurice Guzman, Paul D Stalley, Joshua Zadro, Kate Alexander, Philip Hay, Kai Cheng, Scott Sommerville, Luke Johnson, Richard Carey Smith, Demien Broekhuis, Matthew Broadhead, Richard Boyle
pmc-13337304.description: AimsPelvic reconstruction in the setting of significant bone loss has become increasingly complex, with advancements such as custom 3D-printed prostheses now used in both large oncological resections and revision total hip arthroplasty (rTHA) with massive bone loss. Surgeons must consider how to best reconstruct the pelvis to optimize patient outcomes.

pmc-13456850.title: Association of the blood glucose-to-platelet ratio with all-cause mortality in diabetic patients: An analysis of the MIMIC-IV database
pmc-13456850.creator: Yinan Zhao, Faying Li, Guoying Yu

pmc-13507129.title: Transcript-aware rare genetic variant association analyses of cardiopulmonary traits in participants from the All of Us Research Program
pmc-13507129.creator: Jingwen Zhang, So-hyeon Hong, Xin Wang, Sean J. Jurgens, Ching-Ti Liu, Josée Dupuis, Patrick T. Ellinor, George T. O’Connor, Quanshun Mei, Seung Hoan Choi

pmc-13555395.title: Infantile Epileptic Spasms Syndrome Complicating Mosaic Down‐Turner Syndrome: A Case Report
pmc-13555395.creator: Mohammad Shahrori, Khadeeja Nofal, Hasan H. Alkhawaja, Waed Mohsen, Ainaa A. Alzamari
pmc-13555395.description: Severe baseline developmental delays in complex genetic syndromes like Down‐Turner mosaicism can completely mask the psychomotor regression of Infantile Epileptic Spasms Syndrome (IESS). Clinicians must maintain a high index of suspicion and prioritize early video‐EEG screening for any abnormal paroxysmal movements.

pmc-13623881.title: Probing Bethe strings in an attractive one-dimensional Bose gas
pmc-13623881.creator: Milena Horvath, Alvise Bastianello, Sudipta Dhar, Rebekka Koch, Yanliang Guo, Jean-Sébastien Caux, Manuele Landini, Hanns-Christoph Nägerl
pmc-13623881.description: Bethe strings are bound states of constituent particles in a variety of interacting many-body one-dimensional (1D) integrable quantum models relevant to magnetism, nanophysics, cold atoms and beyond. They are the quantum analogue to bright solitons. As emergent fundamental excitations, they are predicted to collectively reshape observable equilibrium and dynamical properties.

pmc-13678892.title: Bezoar ileus in patients with previous abdominal surgery: an observational comparison of conservative and surgical management
pmc-13678892.creator: Ali Muhtaroğlu, Kayhan Özdemi̇r, Emine Sena Cünük, Merve Yeşi̇lsancak, Alp Ömer Cantürk, Emrah Akin, Fatih Altintoprak
pmc-13678892.description: BackgroundEvidence on the management of bezoar ileus in patients who have already undergone abdominal surgery is limited. We reviewed conservative and surgical pathways in clinically selected patients, with particular attention to patient selection criteria and how each pathway was defined.MethodsWe reviewed 80 patients with CT-confirmed bezoar ileus and previous abdominal surgery who were treated between January 2010 and December 2021.
